_comment: Soldiers 5d sweep seed 9100047 T3 line: Vial on 2, two Esper Sentinels already attacking, hand Champion of the Parish + Recruitment Officer + Jirina (MV2, Vial-able; the Champion is MV1 and cannot swap roles). Best: cast Champion, cast Officer, THEN Vial-put Jirina -> Champion +2. T3 swing 2 (11 -> 9); T4 swing Champion 3 + Officer 2 + Jirina 2 + Sentinels 2 = 9 = lethal. The engine's old line (Jirina (vial), Champion, Officer) leaves Champion at +1 -> 8, no T4 kill.
